title: Building::land_paused is a bool stage kept in step by hand with the old track's player pause state
trigger: Press Play on a voice note, press Pause while it is still loading, press Play again, seek during the load
effect: pause()/resume() flip building.land_paused and pause/play the old track player separately; nothing ties the two, and state() reads only land_paused while a build runs
fix: Building { landing: Landing::{Playing, Held} } with the old sound's pause derived from it

title: Simulation mode is three fields kept in step by hand: simulation, sim_clock, sim_stalled_since
trigger: Demo run with QUILL_DEMO_AUDIO_STALL: seek twice
effect: sim_stalled_since is stamped by the first hung seek (get_or_insert), only stop() clears it, so DeviceStalled sticks for the rest of the track even after later seeks
fix: Backend::{Device{track,building}, Simulated{clock, stalled_since}} one value chosen at start

title: state() ignores Standing::Stale, so a seek made on a track that ran out is undone by the tick as an end
trigger: Play a music file, hold the seek thumb on the bar until the track runs out, drag back and release
effect: seek(offset,false) parks the position with standing=Stale but state() still reads player.empty() as Ended; the next tick sees is_ended(), stops the track and starts the next one instead of seeking
fix: state() maps Stale (or Failed/Stale beside an empty player) to Paused; or seek on an ended track restarts the build

title: VIDEO_OUTPUT RefCell borrow is held across SharedOutput::outlet()/ready_or_wake(), which lock a mutex and may spawn a thread
trigger: Video soundtrack starts or a clip asks video_output_ready() while the output opens
effect: No reentrant borrow today (nothing in outlet() touches VIDEO_OUTPUT), but it breaks panic-safety rule 6 and a future call from there would panic on borrow_mut at line 180
fix: Clone the SharedOutput out of the cell, drop the guard, then call it

title: baseline: Tempo::done
trigger: Play any track to its end, then seek back
effect: done, inner_done and prev (None = first slice) are three flags of the stretcher's stage, and reset() clears each by hand
fix: Stretch::{Starting, Streaming, InputEnded, Done}

title: baseline: Tempo::inner_done
trigger: Play any track to its end, then seek back
effect: inner_done pairs with done and prev; step() reads them in three places and reset() clears them one by one
fix: Stretch::{Starting, Streaming, InputEnded, Done}

title: The active track's data is still spread over seven fields cleared by clear_playback_state (skip 08-039 gives no reason beyond 'still separate')
trigger: Play a voice note, then a music file, then stop
effect: ActiveTrack, track_length, seek_slider, scrub, seek_hover, player.chat, player.meta change together. stop_voice_playback() alone, with an audio track active, wipes that audio track's track_length and seek_slider (every caller today calls both stops in a row, so no visible bug yet)
fix: ActiveTrack::{Voice,Audio}(Track { id, chat, meta, length, slider }) so one take clears all

title: PhoneStep::Sending holds no RequestId; the answer is matched by requests.has_auth_submit() (any auth submit) and last_auth_error.is_some()
trigger: Submit a phone number, then see the answer arrive
effect: sync_phone_step decides accepted vs rejected from the purpose class and a shared error slot, not from the request that Sending sent
fix: Sending { phone, back, request: RequestId } resolved by that id's answer

title: The new-login-prevented box is an Option<Vec<String>> in AuthUi beside account_boxes.notice (OpenNotice) and terms_prompt, with a priority chain in account_notice()
trigger: Decline a new login on another device while a freeze notice is open
effect: One 'which account notice is open' stage is held by three owners; account_notice() picks by if-chain priority, and dismiss clears each by hand
fix: OpenNotice::LoginPrevented(places) variant, one slot

title: A second Enter while a sign-in submit is in flight shows 'Couldn't submit ...' although the first went out
trigger: Type a code, password, phone or recovery code and press Enter twice quickly (also Forgot password? twice, Resend recovery code)
effect: The Enter path ignores the busy state the buttons use; the driver refuses the second send (login_request has_purpose, or an emptied code/password field) and the handler sets StatusNote::error over the success note
fix: Skip the submit while has_auth_submit() (one guard in the submit_on_enter path)

title: cancel_password_recovery writes session.auth_state.password_recovery = Idle from the UI instead of a session transition
trigger: Forgot password, request code, press Back
effect: PasswordRecovery moves Idle/Requested/CodeSent in the reducer and driver but this one transition is a field write from the window layer
fix: Session::cancel_password_recovery() beside the other transitions

title: BackgroundRing keeps dismissed and notified as two bools for the prompt and OS-notification stages of one ring
trigger: Background account rings; close the prompt with Esc; click the OS notification
effect: dismissed/notified are set from the dialog close, the notification path and flush_background_call_picks separately; notified is set before the notification is spawned and never reset
fix: Ring { prompt: Shown|Dismissed, notice: Unsent|Sent }

title: Active::pressed_at is an Option<Instant> used as the 'middle button is down' flag for hold-or-toggle
trigger: Middle-press to anchor, release the button outside the window or after the window loses the mouse-up
effect: Option::take in autoscroll_release is the only exit from 'held'; a lost mouse-up leaves the mode in held state, so it keeps scrolling until a click or focus loss instead of toggling
fix: Active.button: Held{since} | Toggled

title: after_closing polls every 16 ms with no cap and no owner; a Wait that never resolves spins forever and keeps the account in deleting
trigger: Remove an account or log out from the lock screen while a start_connection preparation hangs (screen_preparing never returns to 0) or a preparation for that key never ends
effect: deletion_wait stays Wait on screen_preparing > 0 or prepare.running(key); the detached task loops forever, done never runs and deleting keeps the key
fix: Hold the waiter Task in the waited set with a deadline that turns into CloseWait::Never

title: icon_svg caches a failed read as None for the life of the process
trigger: A bot's icon file is unreadable or not yet an SVG when the attach menu first renders, then the file is replaced at the same path
effect: Cache entry Option::None is never retried or evicted, so the menu keeps the bot glyph until restart; the cache also never shrinks
fix: Cache only successes, or key by (path, mtime)

title: A background client that dies or fails is never started again until the user switches, connects or unlocks
trigger: A signed-in background account's TDLib client stops (bridge.stopped_unexpectedly, or a start fails with Failed); poll_background takes its live and pushes it to closing with restart=false
effect: That account stops notifying and counting unread until the next connect, switch, unlock or disk resume (the only callers of ensure_background_accounts); nothing re-runs the pass on a timer, so the retryable() path is unreachable while the user stays on one account
fix: push_closing(..., restart: matches!(status, Failed)) with a backoff clock, or an ensure pass scheduled by the poll when any client is retryable()

title: BoostPhase::Working carries no RequestId; boost answers are matched by purpose and chat id
trigger: Press Boost (BoostChat or slots read in flight), close the box, reopen it for the same chat and press Boost again; then the first request's error lands
effect: The error arm (state/domains/groups/error.rs) and the ChatBoostSlots arm find the new box by chat id and reset its Working phase to Main with the old error note, so the button re-enables while the second request is still out and a second boostChat can be sent
fix: BoostWork::{Slots(RequestId), Boosting{request: RequestId, reassign}} and compare pending.id in the apply and error arms

title: Opening the Create Bot box resets the create state even while an earlier createBot is in flight
trigger: Press Create, close the box with Esc while Creating (close_bot_create keeps the state on purpose), then open another tg://newbot link or managed-bot button before the answer
effect: open_bot_create calls reset_create_bot unconditionally: stage goes Creating -> Editing and generation is bumped, so the answer no longer matches submission.generation; the bot exists on the server but is never reported, its chat never opens and the keyboard-button share is never answered
fix: reset_create_bot only when !creating(), or keep Creating in the stage and have a new box adopt it

title: EditStage { Loading, Editing } mirrors the session's BotText load stage beside it
trigger: Open the bot edit box; the box's own Loading/Editing and edit.name/about BotText::{Loading,Ready,Failed} must agree
effect: No bug today: loaded is computed from both, and fill_bot_edit (frame upkeep of the hosting window only) moves the box stage when the session stage turns Ready; a box hosted by a window that never draws stays Loading
fix: One stage: the fields are filled from BotText::Ready where it is first read, or the box stage carries the RequestIds it waits for

title: Verify/remove verification is fire and forget: the answer is not matched, a failure is never shown
trigger: Pick a chat and press Verify (or Remove); TDLib refuses (bot not allowed, flood, chat gone)
effect: submit_bot_verify drops the RequestId, sets a silent 'Verifying...' note and returns the box to Pick; no stage waits for the answer, so the pick shows the old state with no error and no end to the note
fix: Step::Sending { request: RequestId, chat } closed by the answer (acks.expect like BoxSend) with the error on the box

title: SimilarBotsFetch is a hand-made Fetch: Loading holds no RequestId, Failed is an absent entry
trigger: Press the similar-bots button on a bot card; the request is lost or answered late
effect: Answers (Loaded) and refusals (remove) are matched by purpose plus the bot's user id, not by the request held in Loading, and absence means both Idle and Failed so a failure cannot show its reason in the panel
fix: HashMap<i64, Fetch<Vec<i64>>> with Loading(RequestId) and Failed(error)

title: Going Back or picking another chat while an Add-bot send is out drops the start payload
trigger: Add a bot as administrator from a link with a start parameter, press Add as admin, then press Back (not disabled while sending) before the promotion answers
effect: belongs_to turns false, pump_box_send runs forget_box_send and drops then_start: the promotion still happens but sendBotStartMessage with the link's parameter is never sent
fix: Disable Back while box_sending(), or keep the follow-up in the session with the request instead of the box

title: baseline: BarFacts::bot_start_pending
trigger: A bot chat with a start parameter or an empty loaded history
effect: No bug: derived from bot_start_params and the history each frame, but it is a stage-named bool and the Start button stays shown until the reducer drops the parameter or a message arrives
fix: BottomBar decided from an enum StartState { NotStartable, Offered, Starting(RequestId) }

title: Unblock and restart sends /start right behind the unblock request, before it is answered
trigger: A blocked bot shows Restart; press it: set_chat_user_blocked returns Ok(Some) and restart_now is true
effect: start_bot_from_bar runs at once while the chat is still blocked on the server; if the unblock then fails the /start is refused and the bot stays blocked with two notes; only a refused or deduped send was guarded
fix: Chain the start on the unblock's answer (stage Unblocking{then_start})

title: StreamReveal::Finishing matches by message id only and is never reset when the chat changes
trigger: A bot reply finishes (Finishing{message}) and the user leaves the chat before the reveal ends; later a message with the same id is drawn in another chat of the account
effect: history.stream_reveal lives in the per-account HistoryUi, not per chat; drawing() ignores the chat, so a colliding id paints the old text's cut (or a stale frozen height) until a draft or the final frame ends it
fix: Key Finishing by ChatMessage and reset to Idle in sync_chat_ui

title: Appearing keeps its width and height animations in step by hand
trigger: Each frame; text_changed from a new draft or the final message
effect: No bug found: width/target_width/start_width/width_duration, height/target_height/shown_height, sweeps (First/Later, a two-variant enum), finalizing and the one-shot fresh bool are updated together in check_line, start_width and text_changed
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Width{tween,target,start}, Height{..} } per line, finalizing as part of the reveal stage

title: emoji_access_shown is only ever added to, and is added before the request is sent
trigger: Flip the Emoji Status switch on a bot profile; the send fails, or access is later revoked elsewhere
effect: The OfAccount set grows for the run and keeps the section visible for a bot that no longer has access (even when the first send failed); nothing clears it on closing the profile
fix: Per-profile stage (ProfileUi) that dies with the profile panel

title: The Linux battery probe loop is detached and keeps probing while the window is hidden or locked
trigger: Linux with no portal or daemon signal and Save Power on Low Battery on: hide or lock the app
effect: The loop spawns a probe (gdbus) every 30 s forever (POLL), with no owner or hidden/locked gate; only the switch-off and event-driven cases park it
fix: Hold the Task in an owner that drops it on hide/lock, or park while no window is visible

title: Chatbots draft Loading is filled by a detached 200 ms polling task, not by the answer
trigger: Open Chatbots; BotLink::Loading waits on getBusinessConnectedBot; business_bot_watch polls Session every 200 ms and copies the answer in; Retry spawns another loop
effect: Nothing wrong today; a second loop per Retry; the draft only fills while a poller lives, so an answer after the poller ended (pump treats not-loading+no-data as done) never reaches the draft
fix: Fill the draft from business_info_upkeep like the other screens (pure function of Fetch state), or hold the Task in BotLink::Loading{task}

title: Pump counts Idle as failed, ends the watcher, and leaves Loading with no Retry
trigger: Chatbots open with GetConnectedBot in flight while a SaveConnectedBot ok/error from a previous leave lands and sets connected_bot = Idle; the 200 ms pump sees not-loading+no data and stops; the real answer then arrives
effect: Screen shows Loading... with no error line and no Retry until the box is closed and reopened
fix: Pump should match Fetch::Failed only; Idle/Loading keep waiting (or drive from upkeep)

title: Save answers write Fetch::Idle over a connected_bot fetch that may be in flight; save_connected_bot also writes Ready over it
trigger: Leave Chatbots with a change (save sent, Ready(bot)); ok lands (Idle); re-enter (fetch R in flight); change and leave again (Ready(bot2) over Loading) then R answers with the older server value
effect: connected_bot shows the old bot (or Idle) after the second save until the next visit refetches
fix: Keep the Loading request id in the stage and only apply the answer whose id is current; a save answer should not rewrite Fetch

title: A failed time zone list shows Loading... with no Retry on the zone screen
trigger: Hours > time zone while getTimeZones failed
effect: The list says Loading... forever; the failure line shows under the box but only Back and re-enter (business_go) or a Save attempt asks again
fix: Draw Fetch::Failed with a Retry button like the links and chatbot screens

title: Saving indicator is a Vec of setting kinds, answered by kind not RequestId
trigger: Leave Greeting (save 1), reopen it, change, leave (save 2); answer 1 arrives
effect: apply_business_ok/error retain-out every entry of that kind, so Saving... goes while save 2 is still out, and a refusal of save 1 is shown as the current one
fix: Vec<(RequestId, kind)> or a per-kind SaveStage::Saving(RequestId) matched on the answer's id

title: Link box save stage lives in the Session and is reset by hand from the box's openers
trigger: open_business and open_business_link_edit call reset_link_save; business_link_save_upkeep resets after Saved; leaving the LinkEdit view mid-save leaves Saving/Saved in the Session
effect: No bug today (Saving carries a RequestId); the box's stage has an owner other than the box and three hand resets
fix: Put the save stage in LinkEditDraft (Saving(RequestId)/Saved) and let the answer be matched on it

title: Sticker panel opened for the start page is closed by hand from three places
trigger: business_go leaving StickerPick, close_business, route_business_start_page_sticker each call close_start_page_stickers; select_sticker_tab(Installed) changes the shared per-account panel
effect: If a new exit path is added the shared sticker panel stays on the Installed tab (and the composer picker inherits it)
fix: Make StartPageSub::Stickers own the panel open (a guard closed on drop/Screen::go)

title: call_window_target returns (call, ringing, ended, busy): two stage bools beside the ids
trigger: sync_call_window reads ended and busy from the tuple and recombines them with CallEnd and lingering
effect: No bug today; Active/Ringing/Ended/Busy are four stages of one thing kept as a tuple
fix: enum CallWindowTarget { None, Active{id}, Ringing{id}, Ended{id}, Busy{id}, Invite{key} }

title: baseline: CallSnap::connecting (beside CallPhase and status)
trigger: Status line is derived by call_status which returns (String,bool)
effect: connecting spins the ring; kept next to phase/status computed together
fix: Fold into CallPhase::Active{connecting} or a CallStatus enum returned by call_status

title: CallEnd::Lingering names a linger timer whose Task is detached, and lingering is read from Instant
trigger: Call ends; sync spawns cx.spawn(timer).detach() and flips Lingering back to Ended when it fires; a second sync decides by at.elapsed()
effect: Works (guarded by call_id); the stage says a timer runs but the timer is not held in it, and tests cannot drive it with a manual clock
fix: Hold the Task in CallEnd::Lingering{task} (dropped on a new call) and take time from a clock the tests control

title: window_closed_by_user and window_open_failed are Option<i32> call-id slots that only the call bar clears
trigger: Close the call window mid-call, end the call, later call again
effect: Nothing clears them at call end; they hold a dead call id (harmless while ids differ) and are one-shot slots with no way out except show_call_window
fix: enum WindowWanted { Open, ClosedByUser(call_id), OpenFailed(call_id) } reset by the call's end

title: CallPanel::devices_menu is reset by hand inside render when the phase leaves Active
trigger: Open the device menu, call ends; render sets devices_menu = None
effect: State written from render instead of by the call's transition; another window of the same call keeps its own copy
fix: Key the menu by call id (Option<(call_id, target)>) and ignore it when the call differs

title: MicTestRun::On names a watchdog whose Task is detached; mic_test_starts counter sits beside the enum
trigger: Start the test, stop, start again within 500 ms
effect: Two watchdog loops run for one test (each exits only when not On); the stage does not own its watcher
fix: Hold the Task in MicTestRun::On and drop it with the stage; keep the token inside Opening only

title: A mic test whose device failed keeps requesting 30 fps animation ticks
trigger: Settings > Calls, Test microphone with no usable device (test.source.error() is Some)
effect: request_animation_tick(30) and last_render.set run before the error early return, so the watchdog never stops the test and the page redraws while it is visible
fix: Return the error before ticking and move a failed test to MicTestRun::Failed(reason)

title: AddPeopleBox.search Option is a created flag and initial_query is a one-shot slot, both set during render
trigger: Open Add People: call_add_people_overlay (render) creates the field, takes initial_query, subscribes and fires search_add_people
effect: Box has two stages (not built, built) as Option + a String taken once; the request is sent from render
fix: enum AddPeopleStage { Opening{initial}, Open{search} } built when the box opens (window passed in)

title: The Add People search state in the Session is cleared by hand at four sites and not by the account's Farewell
trigger: Open Add People, type a name, switch account (CallScreen Farewell closes only the chooser and privacy box) and back
effect: call_boxes.add_people is dropped with OnScreen but Session.calls.add_people_search keeps the query and results until another close path or the call ending clears it
fix: Make the box's close (or Farewell) the single place that clears the search; or own the search inside AddPeopleBox

title: A request is queued from render while the sessions list is Idle and cannot be sent
trigger: Settings > Calls with live set but the chats path inactive (maybe_fetch_active_sessions returns Err, stays Idle)
effect: Every render of the section spawns another screen task that does nothing (no notify, so no loop, but wasted work per frame)
fix: Start the fetch when the section opens (an Asker/opener), not from render

title: HISTORY_AREA keeps the last history area per thread and is never cleared
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance (preview bubbles with a gradient theme) in the window whose chat was last painted, or close the chat
effect: gradient_layer falls back to history_area_of(window) which still holds the old chat geometry, so the preview or any non-history bubble takes a wrong slice of the gradient
fix: Report the area with an explicit owner each frame and clear it when the history stops painting; pass the area to bubbles instead of a thread-local

title: PermissionAsk::Asking sticks when the asking window closes or the screen goes before the system prompt is answered; the poll task is detached
trigger: macOS: press Call or record in a chat window while the camera/microphone is undetermined, close that chat window (or switch account away and back is fine, OnScreen is replaced) before answering the prompt, then answer it
effect: the task's update is refused (ScopedApp::update returns Gone), so recording.permission is never reset to Idle; every later press that needs an undetermined device returns silently at `permission != Idle`: Call, Answer, camera toggle and voice record do nothing until the screen is replaced. The 100 ms poll task also runs until the prompt is answered
fix: Hold the poll Task inside PermissionAsk::Asking {id, call, task} (dropping the stage drops the task), and end the stage from the window-close and screen-farewell paths; or resolve the answer with a channel the stage owns

title: CallTick::{Idle, Running} is a two-variant flag beside the real tick; the loop is spawned with .detach() and Idle is set by hand twice from inside the task
trigger: A call or background ring starts the 1 s tick (ensure_call_tick)
effect: no bug today; Running names a task nobody holds, so it cannot be cancelled by dropping the owner, and Idle is written at the in-loop exit and again after the loop
fix: CallTick::{Idle, Ticking { _task: Task<()> }} like SlowModeTick; drop the second reset

title: CallEnd::Lingering names a running linger timer while the Task is .detach()ed in sync_call_window, and the timer matches by call_id only
trigger: A 1:1 call ends and its window lingers; account switch and back with the same per-account call id while the old timer is pending
effect: an old timer can turn the new account's Lingering back to Ended, so the next sync starts a second timer; harmless today because the close is decided by `at.elapsed()`
fix: Hold the timer Task in CallEnd::Lingering { call_id, at, _timer }, so replacing the stage cancels it; no match by id needed (call_panel.rs:295)

title: CallUi::raised_for is app-wide but holds a per-account call id; CallScreen exists because ids repeat across accounts
trigger: Account A's call 1 rings and raises the open call window (raised_for = Some(1)); the window stays open (a second call or linger) as account B on screen gets its own call 1 ringing
effect: B's ringing call is not raised: raised_for == ringing, so the window is not brought to the front for a call that came in on another account. open_call_window resets it only when a new window opens
fix: Move raised_for into CallScreen (OnScreen, replaced whole on a switch), or key it by (AccountKey, call id)

title: redial dismisses the end summary (and its unanswered rating and uploads) before the dial is accepted; the microphone prompt may still refuse it
trigger: Press Call again on the end card or Redial in the call window with the microphone denied (or the prompt refused)
effect: session.calls.summary is already None, the rating and upload buttons are gone, and no call starts; only a note says access is denied. The comment above says the summary goes only once the dial is accepted
fix: Dismiss the summary inside the continuation that sends the dial (send_dial), after capture access is granted

title: A rating that fails asynchronously loses the draft: submit_call_rating takes rating_detail, and only a synchronous send error puts it back
trigger: Pick stars and problems, type a comment, press Submit; TDLib answers with an error (CallRating::Failed)
effect: the card shows the error and the plain star row again; the problems and stars chosen are gone, and the comment box is cleared by the next open_rating_detail, so the user retypes everything
fix: Keep the draft in the rating stage: CallRating::Sending { request, draft } and Failed { error, draft }, so the answer returns it

title: The rating editor is a second stage in DialogUi (rating_detail: Option<RatingDetail> plus rating_comment_input) next to CallSummary::rating, cleared by hand in dismiss_call_summary and submit
trigger: Rate a call, open the editor, then another call ends and replaces the summary (or the summary is dropped by the reducer)
effect: rating_detail keeps the old call's draft; it is filtered by call_id on read, so it is invisible, but nothing clears it and the comment input keeps the old text until the next open
fix: CallRating::Editing { draft } on the summary itself; the comment input reads from and writes to it

title: sync_call_sounds resets CallBoxes::card_window by hand; four other sites also clear it (answer_call, dismiss_call_summary, dismiss_call_error) and dial_user sets it before the permission answer
trigger: An incoming call arrives while a chat window had pressed Call earlier
effect: the sound sync is where the card's window is cleared for an incoming call, so the card follows the call only because the tick or poll runs; a Call denied at the prompt leaves card_window set until the next dial or dismiss
fix: One call-owned value: ActiveCall/CallSummary carry `card_window` (or CallRoute::{MainWindow, Window(ChatId)}) set by the call's own transitions, not by sound sync

title: With Play sounds off, a mute/connect cue cuts a looping ring and plays nothing: spawn() stops the player before it checks `enabled`; the ring waits out a gap before it resumes
trigger: Play sounds off, a second call ringing during a call, press Mute (play_cue)
effect: the ring is cut for the gap (1 s) although play_cue promises it keeps ringing; player and Loop::On.phase are two fields kept in step by hand (phase set to Playing before spawn)
fix: Return before stop_player when the cue is muted and a loop is on; or make the ring and the cue two slots of one value

title: Editing the draft while Applying writes Editing over the in-flight stage and drops its waiting request ids; closing the box does the same
trigger: Press Apply, then change a swatch (or press Close) before the answers arrive; the first plan fails
effect: the failure is never shown (the ids no longer match), Apply is enabled again and a second plan can race the first on the server; only the 'update requested' note was shown
fix: Disable edits and Apply while Applying (edit_chat_appearance refuses), or keep the in-flight ids in the box until each answers and show a late failure as a note

title: The boost level has no Failed stage: a failed getChatBoostStatus leaves the entry absent, so the box says 'Checking this channel's boost level...' forever
trigger: Open Appearance while getChatBoostStatus fails (offline, error)
effect: the level line never settles and Apply answers LevelUnknown with 'Checking the boost level...' each press; nothing tells the user the check failed
fix: Fetch<(level, boosts)> per chat (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) and a Retry row; Apply on Failed re-asks

title: baseline: LiveInput::failed (with idle) is built from three facts each draw instead of one stage
trigger: Every draw of the stream picture
effect: no bug today; the overlay phase is decided from state: Option<PlayState>, idle: bool and failed: bool, where idle and failed both mean 'no picture expected/possible'
fix: StreamPicture::{Idle, Opening, Playing(state), Failed(detail)} computed once by stream_picture_parts

title: PipWindowStage::Opening is matched to its deferred open by `source` equality, not by an open token held in the stage
trigger: Open a PiP for a stream, close it at once, open another for the same source before the first deferred open lands
effect: the first window is attached to the second link and the second window is closed; one PiP survives but through the wrong window, and a different-source replacement relies on the same match
fix: PipWindowStage::Opening { token: OpenId }; the deferred open applies only when the link's token is its own

title: VolumePill::closes_at names a close timer whose Task is .detach()ed in story_viewer/live_view.rs; four input bools plus a deadline kept in step by hand
trigger: Hover the live story's sound toggle, leave, hover again
effect: each leave spawns a detached timer that only notifies; open() is decided by Instant so it self-corrects, but timers pile up and cannot be cancelled by release()
fix: VolumePill::{Closed, Held(inputs), Closing { task }} holding the timer Task

title: thread-local CACHE.borrow_mut() is held across super::image_budget::retire_all (another module) in the if-let body
trigger: A fourth-and-later palette evicts an entry while retire_all calls wake()
effect: no re-entry into CACHE today, but panic-safety rule 6 forbids a borrow guard across a call into another module
fix: Take the evicted value out of the borrow first (let old = cache.borrow_mut().insert(..);) then retire it

title: sync_capture_block records capture_blocked as applied even when apply_native_sharing did nothing (no window handle / no NSWindow), so a failed block is never retried
trigger: macOS or Windows: the first render of the main or a chat window cannot get its native handle while a secret chat is open
effect: frame.capture_blocked (and ChatWindowView::capture_blocked) says blocked, the window is capturable, and nothing re-applies until the wanted value changes; a secret chat can be screenshotted
fix: apply_sharing returns whether it applied; record the flag only on true (Applied/Wanted/Failed stage)

title: DropOnRow keeps hover beside the drag it belongs to
trigger: hover is set by file and forward drags; forward_takes_over clears it only when the file drag had state, forward_over_row/drag_over_row reset seen without touching it
effect: none today; a row can stay lit with no drag in seen
fix: hover inside Dragged::Files/Forward (a row per drag variant); preview as a demo-only variant

title: Freeze::Frozen with an empty order is a hidden third stage (released, timer still running)
